inspection_method: agent visual review of two-second reference contact sheet and full-resolution payout, closing and light-trail frames

visible_moments: 0-3s: glowing orange trail pulls back from a macro view
3-7s: trail routes through Post, Go viral, Get paid copy
9-11s: orange screen with Connect your bank and Whop badge
16-18s: Get Paid button and pointer interaction
18-22s: orange trail draws a payout evidence card for Otto, $4,000
22-24s: Content Rewards name and scrolling creator results
24-27.84s: star icon, CONTENT REWARDS, Start Earning Today, contentrewards.com

secondary_tools: HyperFrames for path geometry, counters, text and final assembly
structure: Introduce an emissive trail in extreme closeup
Pull back and route it through three short action statements
Resolve the trail into the setup action
Switch to a saturated brand-color band for account setup and earnings
Count up a balance with fixed digit geometry
Follow the same trail into a source-backed proof card
Resolve to a clean, stable brand end frame
style_axes: near-black, orange-red, and white scene contrast
camera_and_motion: controlled scale on the monetary value
brand hold through the final frame
negative_constraints: no invented earnings or testimonial claims

prompt_defaults.subject: Content Rewards creator payouts
prompt_defaults.setting: a graphic canvas alternating near-black, orange-red, and white
prompt_defaults.primary_action: an orange trail connects posting, reach, bank setup, an increasing balance and a payout proof card
prompt_defaults.camera_move: macro-to-wide light trail, precise path follow, count-up and stable closing lockup
prompt_defaults.lighting: emissive orange line head against near-black, flat typography on solid fields

prompt_variants.purpose: Test continuous thin path geometry, controlled pullback and glow preservation without typography.
prompt_variants.prompt: Create a 5-second 16:9 abstract motion graphic. On a uniform near-black background, one bright orange-red horizontal line ends in a small warm glowing tip. Begin close on the thick line and its tip, then smoothly pull the camera back until the stroke is thin and surrounded by generous negative space. The glowing tip moves steadily from left to right, leaving one crisp orange line with a single gentle upward curve. Maintain a clean unbroken stroke and a warm white-orange tip with restrained light bloom. Finish with the thin line across the middle of the frame. No text, no logos, no objects, no particles, no branching lines, no fireworks, no lens flares, no floor.

prompt_variants.purpose: Recreate a complete action-to-proof narrative with replaceable brand, action labels, setup instruction, verified figures and CTA.
prompt_variants.prompt: Build a 27.83-second 16:9 launch video. 0-3s: macro-to-wide orange emissive trail on near-black. 3-7s: guide that trail through three short action labels. 7-9s: resolve to the payout setup action. 9-11s: saturated brand-color account-connection screen. 11-16s: a fixed-width tabular balance counts upward with the caption Available to pay out. 16-18s: pointer presses the payout action. 18-22s: white canvas, same orange trail lands on a payout card with source-supplied proof. 22-24s: brief brand-and-proof handoff. 24-27.83s: supplied icon, brand title, call to action and URL hold. All text, counters, geometric paths and buttons are deterministic. For another use case, replace the brand, labels, setup step, proof values and CTA; require evidence for every numerical claim.
